confidence_notes: Food anchors come from searches of cost-of-living aggregators (citycost.org, last updated Oct 2026: local 0.5L draught about $1.29, cappuccino about $2.65, budget restaurant meal about $3.49, mid-range three-course dinner for two about $19.60) and travel guides. Those guides put General Luna mains at PHP 300-600 and local meals at PHP 150-250. I raised the aggregator figures a little because July 2026 prices will likely be higher and because restaurants in the tourist hubs of General Luna and Cloud 9 charge more. I found no aggregated cocktail or wine prices. I estimated those from the island's ratio of drink prices to beer and from general knowledge of resort bars in the Philippines. Wine is mostly imported and the selection is limited, so the wine anchor is the least certain. All four accommodation anchors are holistic estimates from general knowledge, not from searches. Prices vary a lot between General Luna and the cheaper Del Carmen area, and they rise during the September-October surf season.
comparable_city_reasoning: Siargao is a Philippine island surf destination popular with foreign tourists. Its prices are above typical provincial Philippine levels, about in line with El Nido or Boracay, and close to smaller Bali surf hubs such as Canggu at the lower end.
